_comment: Interactive Brokers MCP for market-data and paper-trading exploration. IB_USERNAME + IB_PASSWORD_AUTH MUST be in the host process env (via .env / shell export) — NEVER inlined here. This file is committed and would leak credentials otherwise. IB_PAPER_TRADING is pinned to 'true' so any MCP call defaults to the paper venue even if a user forgets to set it.
